proposal.description: window_trip is gated by 'converter switching' (S_SS or S_RUN) instead of S_RUN only, so the S_RUN window trip is also allowed through soft start.
proposal.reason: With TRIP_RUN programmed to 0 (trip at any count), window_trip now asserts throughout S_SS, where the run count sits at 0 and the run trip must be held low; in the original it can assert only in S_RUN.
